testing_attributes.mandatory_rule: All interactive buttons, links, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, data table rows, filter chips, and status badges MUST contain explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the navigation header is sticky with a dark/light semi-transparent backdrop blur (NEVER fully transparent without blur/background).
Use standard Lucide icons or Phosphor icons, NEVER use emoji characters for primary icons.
Ensure Toast notifications (using sonner) provide immediate feedback upon submitting admission enquiries, contact messages, and admin CRUD actions.
Admin dashboard should allow viewing, filtering, updating status of admissions enquiries, contact messages, and adding new news/events.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements as requested.
Make sure all forms connect seamlessly to the backend API endpoints (or mock store if required with realistic persistency).
